_about: Wave 0 hazard register (roadmap section 2.6 plus findings from this baseline), statuses refreshed from production facts. 'check' names an automatic evidence check run by generate.js against the repo scan and prod-snapshot.json; hazards without one carry manually verified evidence with a date. 'ownerReview' says what the production-host owner has to decide or confirm; it is false when the status needs no decision. Status vocabulary: open, partial (some of the mitigation is in place), mitigated (the hazard no longer bites as described; the constraint stays), blocked-on-owner (the next step needs the owner), standing-rule. Owners are roles until the production-host owner reviews this register (Wave 0 exit criterion).

hazards.title: Restarting Live drops active RTMP streams
hazards.constraint: RTMP ingest is owned by the Live Node process; a restart disconnects every RTMP broadcaster.
hazards.wave: W7 (OpenRe extraction removes the class); W21 encodes the rule in deploy tooling
hazards.mitigation: Per-slot cutover to OpenRe (ADR-009; OpenVibe.Host docs/cutover-runbook.md section F): OpenRe RTMP listens on 0.0.0.0:1936 since Phase A; each slot moves with its broadcaster present and gets a new key. Until then deploy Live with deploy.sh --wait-idle; ovhost refuses a Live restart while streams are live (tested).
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:24 UTC: 102 of 102 managed_streams rows have ingest_authority=live; Live still listens on *:1935 and OpenRe on 0.0.0.0:1936 (ss). The owner allowed restarts while live for the duration of the roadmap run (operator notes), so this is an accepted, not a removed, risk.
hazards.ownerReview: Schedule per-slot cutover windows with the broadcasters (and confirm port 1936 is open at the provider edge); confirm that restarts while live stay acceptable until then.

hazards.title: Stopping the Live socket unit causes 502s
hazards.constraint: Live uses systemd socket activation; stopping openvibe-live.socket drops the listening socket.
hazards.mitigation: The socket unit no longer has PartOf= on the service (Live c456113), so restarting openvibe-live.service leaves the listening socket up; restart only the service and poll /api/ready.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:28 UTC: openvibe-live.socket active since 17:59:15 UTC while openvibe-live.service was restarted at 20:21:26 UTC (systemctl show ActiveEnterTimestamp).

hazards.title: Media restart during a recording orphans finalisation
hazards.constraint: Recording/finalisation runs inside the Media process. 55 objects / 14.50 GB already sit under B2 vods-orphans/ (21 Sep 2026).
hazards.wave: W4 (reconciliation + duration repair) / W7 (recording ownership to OpenRe)
hazards.mitigation: openvibe-media.service TimeoutStopSec=80 lets a finalisation finish on stop; ovhost refuses a Media restart while a recording is active (tested); recording ownership moves to OpenRe per slot (W7). Reconcile vods-orphans/ before any retention change.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:28 UTC: TimeoutStopUSec=1min 20s on openvibe-media.service. Recording still runs inside the Media process; the 55 objects under B2 vods-orphans/ (21 Sep) have not been reconciled.

hazards.title: managed_streams.stream_key values still need rotation after a past leak
hazards.constraint: Leaked keys remain valid until rotated; a rotation tool was declined earlier.
hazards.wave: W7 (openre.key.rotate) - or earlier as a standalone rotation
hazards.mitigation: The one key committed to a repository (in Live's control-bridge example since ac0d6a47) was rotated on 2026-09-23 and replaced by a placeholder, with the commit allow-listed in the secret scan. The leaked slot keys are rotated per slot at its OpenRe cutover (ADR-009, openre.key.rotate), or by a standalone rotation in Live if the cutover slips.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:28 UTC (counts only, keys never printed): 97 of the 97 slots present in the pre-leak backup live-pre-643a2e6.db still have the same stream_key; 102 slots in total, all ingest_authority=live.
hazards.ownerReview: Choose: rotate the 97 leaked slot keys now in Live (each broadcaster must paste a new key), or rotate each at its OpenRe cutover window; and schedule those windows.

hazards.title: Multilingual Whisper model missing breaks non-English captions
hazards.constraint: Without WHISPER_MODEL_MULTI transcribe.js falls back to the English model.
hazards.mitigation: Install the model and set WHISPER_MODEL_MULTI in live.env.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-22: WHISPER_MODEL_MULTI is set in /etc/openvibe/live.env and the file it names exists on openvibe-oregon (checked with test -f; path not recorded).

hazards.title: YouTube refuses the server IP; the yt tool needs a proxy
hazards.constraint: Environment problem, not code: yt downloads fail from the host address.
hazards.mitigation: Set YT_PROXY and/or YT_COOKIES_FILE for openvibe-tools-yt.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23: neither YT_PROXY nor YT_COOKIES_FILE is set in /etc/openvibe/tools.env; the yt satellite reports youtube "blocked".
hazards.ownerReview: Provide a residential proxy or a cookies file for openvibe-tools-yt, or accept that YouTube downloads stay unavailable.

hazards.title: Workstation root disk near full; headless Chrome can hit ENOSPC
hazards.constraint: Browser acceptance runs on the workstation fail when the disk fills.
hazards.mitigation: Browser harness must support a remote/containerised runner; prune ~/.claude transcripts (~1.2 GB).

hazards.title: A hardcoded internal secret was previously public
hazards.constraint: Any surviving openvibe-internal-* value and the Cloudflare token must be treated as exposed.
hazards.mitigation: Removed: the hard-coded openvibe-internal-2026 value and the hard-coded quest secret (register C-59, Live e505868). New services use Network-issued service tokens; Network records every legacy-key call per route (principal_usage) and the key-only routes have removal dates (register C-50..C-57). Remaining: rotate INTERNAL_API_KEY in every env file, then retire the key routes by their dates.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23: no evidence that INTERNAL_API_KEY was rotated after the exposure; the legacy key still authorises 4 Network routes (about 268 calls in the previous 24 h, principal_usage). The Cloudflare token was replaced by a scoped token that expires 2026-10-07 (see H18).
hazards.ownerReview: Confirm whether INTERNAL_API_KEY was ever rotated after the exposure; approve a coordinated rotation across the env files that still set it.

hazards.title: Removed features and copy rules must not be undone
hazards.constraint: No RobotStreamer promo campaign, no 'free/$0/no ads' copy, never 'Earn Vibes', never call the old theme 'classic'.
hazards.mitigation: Product waves check the prohibitions list (roadmap 9.1) before adding copy or campaigns.

hazards.title: Commit identity
hazards.constraint: Commits must be OpenVibers <Contact@OpenVibe.Network> with no assistant trailers or co-author lines.
hazards.mitigation: Per-repo git config user.email = Contact@OpenVibe.Network; every new commit follows it. Older history keeps some assistant trailers.
hazards.ownerReview: Decide whether the remaining trailers in older main history are rewritten (a force-push per repo) or left as they are.

hazards.title: analytics_events grows without pruning
hazards.constraint: Raw analytics_events is never pruned although hourly/daily rollups exist; Live analytics.db and network.db are the estate's largest stores.
hazards.wave: Track O / ADR-021 - before any schema wave touching Live or Network
hazards.mitigation: ADR-021: no IP, user id or city stored; raw analytics events are pruned after 30 days on a schedule in Live (nightly job), Tools (timer) and Network (openvibe-shared analytics retention.schedulePrune since 9bbd90f), rollups kept.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23: Live analytics.db 1.7 GB -> about 500 MB and network.db 731 -> 276 MB after the prune and VACUUM. The pre-ADR-021 backups that still hold IPs are hazard H17.

hazards.title: No Cloudflare cache-purge step after deploys
hazards.constraint: A cacheable static asset stays stale at some edges until max-age expires; the only Cloudflare token is DNS-01 scoped.
hazards.mitigation: Cache Rules "browser_ttl respect_origin" on every openvibe.* zone and openre.stream (2026-09-23) make the edge follow origin max-age; Search has a purge queue that stays inert until a purge-scoped token exists (CLOUDFLARE_PURGE_TOKEN).
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23: CLOUDFLARE_PURGE_TOKEN is not set in search.env; the workstation Cloudflare token has DNS and rulesets scope only (no purge, no zone settings).
hazards.ownerReview: Mint a purge-scoped Cloudflare token for the Search purge consumer and deploy steps, or accept stale edges until max-age expires.

hazards.title: Production drifts from main
hazards.constraint: A service running an older commit than main means repo-based reasoning does not describe production.
hazards.mitigation: Deploy or record why each lagging service is held back.

hazards.title: Dead and backup database files on the production host
hazards.constraint: Zero-table openvibe.db/hobo.db and a 260 MB pre-migration backup sit in /opt/openvibe.live/data; nothing records whether they are needed.
hazards.mitigation: Confirm no code opens them, then delete the empty files; move copies (backups, import snapshots, rehearsal databases) to /var/backups/openvibe with a retention date.
hazards.ownerReview: Approve deleting the zero-table files and moving or deleting the import snapshots and backups listed by the check.

hazards.title: Media objects with no good copy
hazards.constraint: The first full verification of stored copies found 4 B2 copies whose size does not match the database and 2 missing local files: 6 objects have no verified good copy.
hazards.mitigation: Scheduled copy verification now runs inside Media and reports through /api/ready (object_copies); the 6 objects are marked degraded. Each needs a decision: re-upload from a surviving source, or mark it unrecoverable and tell its owner.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:28 UTC: Media /api/ready degraded object_copies: "6 ready object(s) with no good copy", last verification run 20:28:17 UTC (report: scripts/no-good-copy-report.js).
hazards.ownerReview: Decide for each of the 6 objects (3 public VODs, 1 private VOD, 2 screenshots): re-source or mark unrecoverable.

hazards.title: Off-host backups are unreadable without the backup key, which lives only on the host
hazards.constraint: Nightly `ovhost backup --all --offsite` copies (openvibe-backup.timer) are encrypted with /etc/openvibe/backup.key. If the host is lost and the key has not been escrowed elsewhere, every off-host copy is unrecoverable.
hazards.mitigation: Escrow the key offline (password manager or paper), record its key id (`ovhost offsite check`) next to it, and test a restore from the bucket with the escrowed copy.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:30 UTC: /etc/openvibe/backup.key exists (root, 0600); first scheduled run 2026-09-24 03:36 UTC; the manual 18:47 run covered live, media and games. Escrow cannot be verified from here.
hazards.ownerReview: Confirm the backup key is escrowed off the host.

hazards.title: Pre-ADR-021 analytics backups still hold IP addresses
hazards.constraint: The safety copies taken before the ADR-021 scrub keep raw IPs, user ids and cities until they are deleted.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23 20:23 UTC production snapshot: the Live and Tools copies are present (see the dead-dbs check under H14).

hazards.title: The Cloudflare API token expires on 2026-10-07
hazards.constraint: DNS records and cache rules for every zone are managed with a workstation-only token that expires 2026-10-07 and has no zone-settings, purge or token-creation scope. After expiry no DNS or cache change can be made by the agents.
hazards.mitigation: Mint a replacement before 2026-10-07 (DNS + rulesets, plus purge if H12 is to be closed); keep it off the server.
hazards.evidence: 2026-09-23: token scope and expiry recorded when it was issued; not re-checked against the Cloudflare API in this run.
